prototypes.title: Refine the Vault Reliquary
prototypes.body: Test the selected card direction with real published characters. Change the sample, finish, size, and render framing before it replaces the production card.

vaultSteel.title: Vault Steel
vaultSteel.body: The thin perimeter swells into shallow metal nameplates at the center of the upper and lower edges.

reliquary.title: Hero Reliquary
reliquary.body: Class and spec become opposing crests around the class-colored name. The character stands above a compact museum-style score plinth.

vaultRelic.title: Vault Reliquary
vaultRelic.body: Realm, name, and guild lead into an uninterrupted portrait. Quality and combat identity share one line above a compact score deck and raid-themed lower seal.

warBanner.title: War Banner
warBanner.body: Warm bronze clasps hold the class and spec above a broad portrait. The raid name hangs from the bottom frame like a military pennant.

raidGate.title: Raid Gate
raidGate.body: Cool portal brackets hold class and spec above the character while role and guild crests anchor the lower corners.

scoreForge.title: Score Forge
scoreForge.body: The character owns nearly the full card height while square instrument housings and a machined score rail define the edges.

fullBleed.title: Full-Bleed Champion
fullBleed.body: A near-borderless treatment gives the raid and character maximum space. Circular corner halos and floating scores keep the frame light.

archiveSeal.title: Archive Seal
archiveSeal.body: Blackened corner plaques and a dense two-column record make the card feel preserved, numbered, and built for a collection binder.

infoDialog.title: About This Site
infoDialog.description: This is a completely fan-made passion project — not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment in any way. It was built just for fun to help the Finnish World of Warcraft community keep track of guild raid progress.
infoDialog.community: The goal is simple: give Finnish WoW players one place to see how our guilds are doing in current raid content. Whether you're pushing Mythic or just following the race, this site is for you.
infoDialog.noMonetization: There are no ads, no tracking, no monetization. This project doesn't make any money — it's purely a labor of love for the community.
infoDialog.asIs: Everything here is provided as-is. Things might break sometimes, data might lag behind, and features come when there's time to build them.
infoDialog.contact: If something looks wrong, is broken, or you have ideas for improvements — don't hesitate to reach out on Discord! Feedback and suggestions are always welcome.
infoDialog.dataSource: Data sources: Warcraft Logs, Raider.IO, and Blizzard API
